ChargebackBot: ALERT: ACH return detected for txn pay_2026_7721. Return code: R03 (No account/unable to locate account). Amount: $4,320.00. Customer: Acme Data Labs (acct: acme-789). Case opened: cb_9876.

Devin: @Marta can you pull the invoice, ACH authorization and any signed MSA/TOU? Need bank-level remittance and payer bank name for the rebuttal pack.

Marta: On it. Quick heads-up — I think we have a signed ACH authorization dated 2025-11-01 in the customer folder. Pulling invoice INV-2026-1142 now.

Devin: Posting transaction snippet we have so far:
```
payment_id: pay_2026_7721
amount: 4320.00
currency: USD
method: ACH
return_code: R03
bank_return_msg: "No account/unable to locate account"
customer_id: acme-789
invoice: INV-2026-1142
created_at: 1812342000
settled_at: 1812345600
processor: RiverbankPay
route: ACH-STD
```

Ara: Please place the account on temporary hold (no provisioning changes) and flag for manual billing review. @Marta and @Ryan we should also freeze any new seat additions until this is cleared. Suggest 7-day hold while we compile evidence.

Ryan: Noted. This is an annual enterprise subscription with auto-renew. If we can produce: (1) signed ACH authorization, (2) invoice + delivery logs, (3) correspondence showing payment intent, we should contest. Otherwise, we may need to accept a refund. Pausing provisioning for now.

Marta: Found the ACH auth PDF and saved to ticket cb_9876: https://redwood.internal/finance/archive/acme-789/ACH_AUTH_20251101.pdf
Also attached invoice and SSO delivery logs.

Devin: I'm pinging the account exec to get the payer name and banking contact. Reaching out to Acme: "Can you confirm the account that initiated payment? We received an ACH return R03 for payment INV-2026-1142." I'll add their response to the ticket.

Ara: Add IP and usage proof to the evidence pack. We need: API call logs (delivery timestamps), support chat transcript, billing email confirmations. Also ask Legal to weigh in on any arbitration clause.

Ryan: If Legal signs off, we'll assemble a dispute rebuttal and submit to RiverbankPay within the processor windows. Also log any pattern — check last 12 months for multiple ACH returns from same customer.

Marta: Putting together the evidence checklist now and will upload to cb_9876. ETA 90 minutes.

Devin: Thanks — I'll mark this thread P1 and leave the hold in place. @ChargebackBot update expected once we submit. :white_check_mark:
